notes.title: Witch Amelia English Version Available 17/11/23
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956362/ea498c1f5f90ed1a5b2bb8ec9c6a2b8053afe729.png[/img]

[h3]We're thrilled to announce that the English version of "Witch Amelia" will be released on November 17th!
Join Rody and Amelia on their enchanting adventure and discover if their bond can withstand the trials ahead. 

Don't forget to also follow us on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/hanabigames]Steam Publisher page[/url] and gain the latest information![/h3]
